$schema.description: The schema version of the kin file.

version.description: The version of the kin file.

name.description: The name of the kin. Kins are also created through the API, so there is no fixed list.

movement.description: How far a character of this kin moves before agility adds or takes.

description.description: A description of the kin. Not stored: the table has no column for it.
